entities.summary: Mingyi Swa Saw Ke, also called Bǔ Là Làng (卜剌浪), in Ming History, was king of Ava from 1367 to 1400. He reestablished central authority in Upper Myanmar (Burma) for the first time since the fall of the Pagan Empire in the 1280s. He essentially founded the Ava Kingdom that would dominate Upper Burma for the next two centuries.
